import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix species label variants: normalize to title case
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (handle commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (already numeric type per profile, but sample shows string with negative)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Drop rows with negative flipper_length_mm (invalid per rules)
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Drop rows where body_mass_g is out of range (2500 to 6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
